name: youtube-exact-upload-date
description: Firefox extension that replaces YouTube relative upload times with exact dates.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files test scripts package-lock.json .github README.md LICENSE
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files test scripts package-lock.json .github README.md LICENSE
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint
